text:
Estimated from the before and after photos, using typical portion sizes.

Before the meal, the tray held:
- Cannelloni, 2 pieces with sauce and cheese: about 280 g, 450 kcal.
- Pot roast beef with potatoes: about 150 g, 280 kcal.
- Fruit salad: about 150 g, 80 kcal.
- Mixed vegetables with corn and carrots: about 130 g, 90 kcal.
- Bottle of drink (looks like apple juice or a similar drink): the bottle is empty in the second photo, about 250 ml, 110 kcal.
- Water: 0 kcal.

After the meal:
- The beef plate is clean, so all of it was eaten.
- The cannelloni plate has some leftovers, roughly 60 g, so about 220 g was eaten, around 355 kcal.
- The vegetables are mostly left, about 40 g remaining, so about 90 g was eaten, around 62 kcal.
- The fruit bowl has leftovers of about 60 g (apple, blueberries and melon), so about 90 g was eaten, around 50 kcal. The second photo shows a different fruit mix, but it is probably the same serving.
- The drink bottle is empty, so all of it was consumed.

Totals:
- Energy: 355 + 280 + 62 + 50 + 110 = 857 kcal, which I round to about 850 kcal.
- Mass: 220 + 150 + 90 + 90 = 550 g of solid food, plus about 250 g of drink, giving about 800 g.
